description: Check Memoreal Cloud service status, total organization memory count across all namespaces, and rolling 30-day API quota usage (read-only, idempotent; consumes 1 Read API call on tools/call) and return { status, memory_count, used_calls_30d, api_call_limit }. Takes no parameters; api_call_limit is null on Unlimited plans. Use to verify connectivity and overall organization quota headroom; use stats instead when you need memory counts scoped to one specific project namespace.
name: health

api_call_limit.description: Rolling 30-day quota cap, or null for unlimited.

memory_count.description: Total memories across all organization namespaces.

title: Check Memoreal Health
